newsitem.title: USA: Energy Ventures to buy Geremia for $24 mln.
newsitem.headline: Energy Ventures to buy Geremia for $24 mln.

text.p: Energy Ventures Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed to buy Brazilian-based progressive cavity pump designer and manufacturer Irmaos Geremia LTDA for about $24 million in cash and assumed debt.
Geremia had revenues of about $25 million a year and controlled an estimated 19 percent of the world progressive cavity pump market, Energy Ventures said in a statement.
The acquisition was due to be completed within the next two weeks and Geremia would be integrated into Energy Ventures' artificial lift and completion tool business, called EVI Oil Tools.
"The company believes Geremia's product line is technologically state of the art and in many respects complementary to Energy Ventures' Rotalift line of progressive cavity pumps," it said.
